BAJAJ_AUTO.notes: EPS 469.85 is Screener's consolidated quarterly sum (98.38 + 131.02 + 115.41 + 125.04); the company's press release gives no consolidated EPS. net_profit 12,815 is Screener's consolidated profit line, which INCLUDES minority interests (2,750 + 3,492 + 3,189 + 3,384); profit attributable to owners is known only for two of the four quarters: 3,661.92 in January-March 2026 (news) and 3,436.10 in July-September 2026 (Autocar Professional). FY26 consolidated PAT 10,744 (company press release), Screener EPS 384.41. ONE-OFF GAINS (company's Q4 FY26 press release): the January-March 2026 quarter's 'share of profit of associate' of 1,195 crore consists of a 953 remeasurement gain on the existing investment at the acquisition date, a 646 reclassification of accumulated foreign currency translation gain, a 413 share of the investee's loss from 1 July 2025 to the acquisition date, and 9 of associate profit to 31 December 2025. Gross one-off gain 1,599 crore (about 12% of 12-month profit); net of the catch-up loss, 1,195, which news reports call the 'one-time gain'. The release states no tax on these and no per-share effect. KTM (BAIHAG) has been a subsidiary since 18 November 2025; the excess of net assets over consideration went to capital reserve, not to profit. Auditors gave a qualified opinion on uncertainties at BAIHAG (news). Also a 35 crore standalone exceptional gain on prepayment of a sales-tax deferral loan in the same quarter (below 3%). Standalone PAT: FY26 9,825; Q4 FY26 2,746; Q2 FY27 3,353.76; H1 FY27 6,336.60. Tax rate 24% from Screener (FY26; 19% in the quarter with the gain). No EPS or profit guidance found. Company's Q2 FY27 release not opened.

COALINDIA.notes: EPS 54.13 = 11.61 (Q3 FY26) + 17.59 (Q4 FY26), both in the company's audited FY26 results filing on NSE, + 14.36 + 10.57 (Q1 and Q2 FY27, Screener). Owners' profit 33,406 = 31,094.29 (FY26, company filing) - 13,056 (H1 FY26) + 15,368 (H1 FY27), the last two from Upstox's news summary (primary false for that reason); using Screener's half-year EPS instead of quarters gives 54.21 (FY26 50.46 - 21.18 + 24.93; the FY25/FY26 quarters were restated for coal levies). FY26: owners' profit 31,094.29, total profit 31,070.58, EPS 50.46. NO one-off gain is identified by the company and there are no exceptional items. Things to know, none listed as a one-off gain: (1) stripping-activity provision write-backs credited 'in a systematic manner': 670.56 in Q4 FY26, 1,964.90 in FY26 (2,881.75 in FY25) - recurring by design, balance 56,503.61 still to be released; (2) 'liability and provision written back' 2,931.78 in FY26 (2,495.78 in FY25, cash-flow statement) - also recurs yearly; (3) other income is seasonally high in the March quarter: 5,127.72 in Q4 FY26 (3,939.15 in Q4 FY25), FY26 11,275.68; (4) coal levies moved from agent to principal treatment with prior periods restated - grosses up revenue and expense, FY25 pre-tax profit +197.25; one news article says this inflated Q4 profit but the filing shows no gain from it in FY26. One-off CHARGES in the 12 months (ignored per brief): executive pay provision 1,457.90 for 23 Aug 2023 - 31 Dec 2025; impairment of coal blocks 608.81 (FY26). Tax rate 25.9% = 10,852.51 / 41,923.09 (FY26, my calculation). No profit guidance. The Q2 FY27 filing itself was not opened.

HAL.notes: July-September 2026 results came out today (12 Nov 2026); only news summaries were readable. EPS 143.36 = FY26 136.30 (Screener) - H1 FY26 45.65 + H1 FY27 52.71 (Free Press Journal; the article labels them Q2 but they are half-year figures). Net profit 9,588 = 9,116 - 3,052.82 + 3,525.30. HCLTECH.notes: EPS 67.51 is Screener's sum of four quarters (15.02 + 16.54 + 17.04 + 18.91); the company publishes only last-twelve-month diluted EPS and I could not open its Q2 FY27 investor release. Net profit 18,322 = 4,076 (Q3 FY26, reported incl. labour codes) + 4,488 (Q4 FY26) [both from the company's Q4 FY26 investor release on NSE: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/HCLTECH_21042026180629_InvestorRelease.pdf] + 4,626 (Q1 FY27, Screener) + 5,132 (Q2 FY27, company press release). CONFLICT: Kotak Neo quotes 'diluted EPS 70.22' for Q2 FY27; this looks like the company's LTM EPS excluding the labour-codes charge (the Q4 FY26 release gave FY26 EPS 64.01 on that basis and 61.36 as reported), not the reported figure. FY26 reported net income 16,642, adjusted 17,361. No one-off GAINS found in company documents. One-off CHARGES inside the 12 months (ignored): labour codes 956 at EBIT / 719 after tax in October-December 2025; restructuring (81 bps of EBIT margin in Q3 FY26, 122 bps in Q4 FY26). Screener shows a 21% tax rate in January-March 2026 and July-September 2026 against 24-26% in other quarters; I found no company explanation, so no tax gain is listed (not verified). Tax rate 24.7% is my calculation for FY26 (5,450 / 22,102). No EPS or profit guidance: FY27 revenue growth 2.5-4% in constant currency, EBIT margin 17.5-18.5%.

HINDZINC.notes: Screener consolidated quarters: EPS 9.27 + 11.91 + 12.94 + 15.18 = 49.30; net profit 3,916 + 5,033 + 5,469 + 6,412 = 20,830 (no minority interests). Company-sourced cross-checks: FY26 net profit 13,832 (integrated annual report, CFO statement); Q4 FY26 5,033 and EPS 11.91; Q2 FY27 6,412 and H1 FY27 11,881 (news reproductions of the release). No exceptional items and no one-off gains reported in any page read; other income is steady (280-374 per quarter). The 12-month profit is far above the last fiscal year (20,830 vs 13,832) because of metal prices, silver above all (the CFO statement says silver was about 45% of FY26 profit) - a commodity-price effect, not a one-off item in the accounting sense. Tax rate 25% from Screener (FY26). No profit or EPS guidance found (FY27 capex guidance of 500-600 million US dollars only). Company's results filing and call transcript were not opened; the Finology page failed.

Exceptional CHARGES in the 12 months (ignored per brief): restructuring 35.0 and labour codes 10.37 in Q3 FY26; 36.17 in Q4 FY26; 99.2 in H1 FY27 (earlier growth-facts file).
